label: H.R. 7128
title: TRIA Program Reauthorization Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill reauthorizes the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program through 2034.
The program covers a portion of the losses incurred by private insurers for property and casualty insurance coverage for terrorism risk.
